title.narrative: Trade and Competitiveness Program, Subprogram 1

description.narrative: The program will help the Government of Cambodia enhance the country's international competitiveness and diversify the economy, in turn helping the country to recover economically from the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, achieve a higher income status, and improve the livelihoods of its citizens. The program supports three reform areas: (i) enhancing the enabling environment for investment and business; (ii) growing micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs); and (iii) improving trade policy and enhancing trade facilitation.

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Feb 01, 2020 - Aug 31, 2022

description.narrative:
Action 1: 1.1. The government will submit a new Investment Law to the National Assembly , providing: (i) greater protection for investors' rights; and (ii) a legal framework for transparent, predictable, and non-discriminatory fiscal and non-fiscal incentives for priority sectors that are targeted and timebound; and the government will issue a sub-decree to implement the law, establishing 25 Capital-Provincial Investment Sub-Committees that will improve and accelerate the review and approval of local-level private investmentsb and provide consistent one-stop-services to investors. (MEF and Council for the Development of Cambodia) Target date: 2022-08-31
Action 2: 1.2. The government will launch phase 2 of the OBR, onboarding four ministriesc and enabling them to issue specialized digital business licenses, certificates and permits through the single online portal. (MEF) Target date: 2022-08-31
Action 3: 1.3. The government will adopt the National Science, Technology & Innovation Roadmap 2030, to improve R&D, facilitate collaboration and networking, and enhance the enabling environment, with a target for women in STEM. f (MISTI) Target date: 2022-08-31
Action 1: 2.1 The government will implement the Investment Law by issuing a sub-decree that specifies the investment application processes and requirements for enterprises, and standardizes government investor aftercare services for investment projects. (MEF and Council for the Development of Cambodia) Target date: 2024-08-31

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Sep 01, 2022 - Aug 31, 2024

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Enhancing the enabling environment for investment and business Outcome 1: a. At least 55 digital business licenses, certificates and permits issued through the OBR (2020 baseline: 0) (Source: MEF)
Action 2: 2.2 The government will expand the scope of online issuance of specialized business licenses, permits, and certificates by onboarding five more agencies to the Oric. (MEF) Target date: 2024-08-31
Action 3: 2.3 The government will: (i) submit to the National Assembly a draft Law on Commercial Court Procedures, which will strengthen enforcement of contracts and resolution of domestic commercial disputes; and (ii) develop and deliver specialized knowledge resources and training courses for Commercial Court judges. (MOJ) Target date: 2024-08-31
Action 4: 2.4 The government will submit to the National Assembly a Technology Transfer Law to promote technology diffusion from universities to the private sector, between sectors, and from foreign to local firms. (MISTI) Target date: 2024-08-31
Action 1: 3.1 The government will submit to the National Assembly a draft Law on Special Economic Zones to increase foreign investment and promote backward and forward linkages between SEZ investors and domestic companies. (MEF and Council for the Development of Cambodia) Target date: 2026-08-31

Policy 2: Growing micro, small, and medium-sized businesses NA
Action 2: 1.5. The government will: (i) establish an institutional structure and governance arrangementsh for the promotion of Inclusive Business in Cambodia; and (ii) launch an Inclusive Business accreditation mechanism, to make economic growth more inclusive for women, young entrepreneurs, and low-income groups. (MISTI, MEF) Target date: 2024-08-31
